name: The Hundred (Reformer)
summary: Head and chest curled up, arms pumping with straps while the legs hold tabletop or extend.

layers.title: Head down, tabletop
layers.text: Arms pump with the head resting.

layers.title: Head up, tabletop
layers.text: Curl the head and chest up.

layers.title: Legs extended
layers.text: Extend the legs to a height that keeps the back still.

cautions.note: Avoid curling the head up while lying on the back later in pregnancy; offer headrest up and head down.
Head curl is loaded flexion; keep the head down.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
